action_items: (Cleanup, optional) Backend evidence-upload tests created 'TEST_ Upload' & 'TEST_ FB' evidence docs which were deleted within the same tests. Metric 1.2.1 current_value was modified during testing (97→98 then 99 via UI); the seeded value may differ from the original. Main agent can re-seed if exact demo numbers matter.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_comply.py (517 lines) — well structured, all queries use {_id: 0} projection (no ObjectId leakage). _coerce_iid enforces cross-tenant guard on every authenticated endpoint. ADMIN_ROLES/WRITE_ROLES separation matches spec.
projected_grade() thresholds match the spec exactly (A++/A+/A/B++/B+/B/C).

AQAR generator has robust LLM-fail fallback (deterministic markdown template with criterion description + metrics + evidence blocks). Verified Claude path returned a full 500+ word formal AQAR text containing tenant name + academic year.
OBE upsert uses $setOnInsert for created_at and id — correct idempotent upsert pattern.
Pydantic Field(ge=0, le=3) on CoPoMappingBody.level returns 422 for level=4 (FastAPI default validation error). Spec expected 400 — minor; not a functional issue, validation still rejects.
Evidence upload writes file synchronously to disk inside async handler with `with open()` — would benefit from aiofiles for high throughput; not blocking for current demo scale.
_criterion_score is called once per criterion (N=7) on every /dashboard and /readiness — acceptable, but could be batched if metrics-count grows substantially.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all required testids present, all flows verified including AQAR Claude generation
